summary: Inventory application is serving on node1 TCP port 8181 under an enforcing AppArmor profile. It is enabled at boot and recovered successfully after node1 was restarted.
actions_performed: Created the inventory HTTP application and dedicated inventory system user.
Added and loaded the inventory-service AppArmor profile in enforce mode.
Verified the UI, health endpoint, inventory data, listener, and enforcing process confinement.
Restarted node1 safely and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP port 8181
evidence.summary: Direct socket and HTTP checks show a listener on *:8181, successful health and inventory responses, and HTTP 200 from the Inventory Application UI before and after restart.
AppArmor reports 14 enforcing profiles, zero complain-mode profiles, and the live inventory process as inventory-service (enforce), including after restart.
inventory.service was enabled and active; its unit and AppArmor profile remain present after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 0256e3f5-9f2d-48f3-b55b-12f9f4d599ab; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; node1 returned with changed boot ID bac65080-68a4-4e38-962a-4b416b726695; the enabled service, listener, inventory data, and enforcing AppArmor confinement all recovered.
